transcript: Speaker A (Human): Teacher ne bola ghar mein English mein baat karo. Mujhe toh apna naam bhi likhna nahi aata. [Teacher said to speak English at home. I don't even know how to write my name.] Speaker B (AI): Aapko poori English nahi, bas bete ka homework samajhne aur teacher se baat karne jitni seekhni hai. [You don't need full English, just enough to understand homework and talk to teachers.] Speaker A: Par main padhi-likhi nahi hoon, mujhse hoga? [But I'm uneducated, can I do it?] Speaker B: Bilkul. English Seekho app mein sab Hindi mein samjhaya hai. Sirf video dekhna aur sunna hai. [Yes. English Seekho app explains everything in Hindi. Just watch and listen.] Speaker A: School mein toh mushkil English hoti hai. [School English is very difficult.] Speaker B: Aap basic seekho. Roz ke 10 easy sentences. [Learn the basics. 10 easy sentences daily.] Speaker A: Bete ko homework mein kaise help karungi? [How will I help my son with homework?] Speaker B: Good manners ke words seekho jaise Please, Thank you. Dono saath mein seekho. [Learn polite words like Please, Thank you. Learn together.] Speaker A: Mujhe sharam aati hai basic seekhne mein. [I feel ashamed learning basics at my age.] Speaker B: App mein koi judge nahi karega. AI coach 24 ghante available hai jo Hindi se English sikhayegi. [No one will judge. The AI coach is available 24/7 to teach English via Hindi.] Speaker A: Sach mein kar paungi? [Can I really do it?] Speaker B: Ek mahine mein aap teacher se baat kar paogi. English Seekho app download karo. [In one month, you'll be able to talk to teachers. Download English Seekho.] Speaker C (Voiceover): Install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click install and download English Seekho.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. Disclaimer: English Seekho is not affiliated with any government authority. Results depend on individual effort.
summary: An anxious mother shares her fear of not being able to help her child with schoolwork due to her lack of English skills. An AI avatar guides her to use the English Seekho app, highlighting its simple Hindi-based video lessons and non-judgmental 24/7 AI coach. The ad ends with a call to action to download the app.
